summary: End-to-end test of the new /admin/users management page + supporting backend endpoints. 10/11 backend pytest cases pass; the only failure is POST /api/analytics/admin/users/{id}/send-reset-link returning 500. All frontend flows verified: page rendering, search, active/suspended/all filter, suspend modal, suspend->Suspended badge, restore->Active badge, pagination present, admin-only forbidden screen for non-admin, and /admin -> 'Manage all users' link wired up. parent1@test.com left in unsuspended/Active state at the end of the run.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error. analytics_routes.py:491 calls `_send_setup_email(to_email=email, link=link, mode="signin", name=...)` but the underlying email_service.send_magic_link() signature is `send_magic_link(*, to_email, link_url, user_name=None)`. Three problems: (1) wrong kwarg `link` should be `link_url`, (2) wrong kwarg `name` should be `user_name`, (3) extraneous kwarg `mode` is not accepted, (4) the function is sync (def, not async) but the call uses `await`. Backend log shows `TypeError: send_magic_link() got an unexpected keyword argument 'link'`. The fallback `EmailNotConfigured` path is never reachable because the TypeError fires before SMTP is contacted.

integration_issues.issue: Triggers backend 500. The UI correctly surfaces a 'Could not send reset link.' error toast (graceful), but the feature itself is broken because of the backend bug above. Once the backend is fixed, the fallback clipboard-copy path (when SMTP not configured in preview) should also work end-to-end.

action_items: Fix analytics_routes.py admin_send_reset_link: change the email call to `_send_setup_email(to_email=email, link_url=link, user_name=doc.get('name') or '')` and drop `await` (the function is sync). Or import the async sender. After fix, the existing pytest case `test_send_reset_link_creates_magic_link` will pass without changes.
Optional: wrap the email-send call in try/except for unexpected TypeError to avoid leaking 500s if the email backend ever changes signatures again.
critical_code_review_comments: analytics_routes.py:488-496 — the alias `_send_setup_email = send_magic_link` is misleading (one name suggests setup mode, the other signin). Prefer importing send_magic_link directly and use it without alias.

analytics_routes.py:486 — the fallback link uses `public_url` from env; in preview PUBLIC_APP_URL is unset and the relative `/auth/magic?token=…` is returned. Frontend correctly prepends window.location.origin before copying to clipboard, so this works — but worth documenting.

auth.py:103-104 — `if doc.get('suspended'): return None` in `_user_by_id` silently turns suspended users into 401s on every authenticated call. Good defense-in-depth, but consider returning a 403 with a clear message via a separate dependency for already-signed-in tokens, so the suspended user gets actionable feedback in the UI instead of an unexplained logout.
analytics_routes.py:355 — regex-escape loop builds the escape set including stray backslash; works but `re.escape(q_safe)` from stdlib is cleaner and exhaustive.

AdminUsers.jsx:144 — `window.location.origin + data.link` is prepended only if backend returns a path-relative link. If backend ever returns an absolute URL, prefix will produce an invalid double-origin URL. Consider `data.link.startsWith('http') ? data.link : window.location.origin + data.link`.

success_rate.backend: 10/11 pytest (91%) — 1 hard failure on send-reset-link due to TypeError

test_credentials: Used existing admin (mattsossi@bsossi.com / AdminPass123!) and parent1@test.com / TestPass123!. Both confirmed working. parent1 is ACTIVE at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_users.py covers auth gating, listing shape, search, suspended filter, include_guests, limit clamping (max 200), self-suspend block, full suspend->login-403->unsuspend->login-200 cycle, and reset-link. Re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_users.py -v`. Frontend dismissed legal modal via localStorage key `sac_legal_ack_v1` = `{version: 'v1', at: ISO}`. The Reset Link bug is in analytics_routes.py admin_send_reset_link calling send_magic_link with wrong kwargs; once fixed, the fallback path should return 200 with `{ok:true, emailed:false, reason:'smtp-not-configured', link:'/auth/magic?token=...'}` in preview.
rca of the issue: Reset-link 500: signature mismatch between admin_send_reset_link (analytics_routes.py:491) and email_service.send_magic_link. Fix: change the call to `send_magic_link(to_email=email, link_url=link, user_name=doc.get('name') or '')` (no await, no `mode` arg) and the EmailNotConfigured fallback path returns the magic link for clipboard copy — exactly what the AdminUsers.jsx UI expects.
